subject: general
question:
Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 1 1 4 3 4 8 2 5 2 4 8 3 1 3 8 3 3 4 3 2 8 9 7 3 4 2 8 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 1 1 4 3 4 8 2 5 2 4 8 3 1 3 8 3 3 4 3 2 8 9 7 3 4 2 8 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Odd — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ba2f9129a7bb4d96cbb2e000229f4c080c2f1736e3acf18dd5381dc9faae1c3.png] 

Thus, there are 3 odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
